newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firm on API figures.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firm on API figures.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures were quoted higher Wednesday on firm sentiment caused by a fall in American Petrolem Institute (API) crude figures, brokers said.
Levels were quoted higher on the fall in API's crude oil stocks and the market still has momentum of move higher, a broker said.
The January contract was bid/asked at $23.45/$23.47 up from its last close on London's IPE at $23.38 a barrel.
February was bid/asked at $22.95/$23.05 against its last close at $22.92.
Brokers said they see prompt month resistance at between $23.50-$23.75.
The API stock figures showed a drop of 3.5 million barrels in crude oil stocks, distillate stocks rose by 920,000 barrels and gasoline fell by 535,000 barrels.
The after-hours ACCESS system was last bid at $23.57, up eight cents from its last NYMEX close, while January was last traded at $23.26, six cents over its previous close.
